skill_drafts.name: OpenAI Agents Python Integration Setup
skill_drafts.description: Install and configure the OpenAI Agents SDK for Python to enable agent development and monitoring. Use when starting a new Python-based agent project that requires OpenAI integration.
applicable_signals: No prior OpenAI Agents installation detected
contraindications: Using TypeScript or non-OpenAI agent frameworks
Project uses alternative LLM providers exclusively
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Run pip install command', 'detail': 'Execute: pip install openai-agents'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Verify installation', 'detail': 'Import openai_agents in Python REPL or test script to confirm successful installation'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Review integration documentation', 'detail': 'Consult Python integration guide and OpenAI Agents Python documentation for framework-specific setup'}
triggers: Starting a new Python agent project
constraints: pip package manager must be accessible
Internet connectivity required for package download
output_contract: openai-agents package installed and importable; Python environment ready for agent development; caller can proceed to agent code development

metadata.prompt: Install the openai-agents package via pip. Verify installation by importing the package in your Python environment. Consult the Python integration guide and OpenAI Agents Python documentation for framework-specific configuration steps.

skill_drafts.name: CrewAI Observability Auto-Monitoring
skill_drafts.description: Enable automatic monitoring and observability for CrewAI agents by setting the AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable. Provides dashboard visibility of crew execution with minimal code changes.
applicable_signals: AgentOps account and API key provisioned
contraindications: AgentOps API key not available or not provisioned
Observability not required or not permitted by deployment policy
workflow_steps: {'step': 1, 'action': 'Obtain AgentOps API key from AgentOps account', 'note': 'Ensure key is valid and has appropriate permissions'}
{'step': 2, 'action': 'Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY environment variable', 'note': 'Can be set via shell export, .env file, or deployment platform secrets'}
{'step': 3, 'action': 'Deploy or run CrewAI crews', 'note': 'No code changes required; auto-instrumentation activates on environment variable detection'}
{'step': 4, 'action': 'Verify crew execution appears on AgentOps dashboard', 'note': 'Check dashboard for crew runs, task execution, and agent interactions'}
triggers: Deploying CrewAI agents to production or staging
Need real-time observability of crew execution
constraints: AGENTOPS_API_KEY must be set in environment before crew initialization
AgentOps account and valid API key required
CrewAI framework must be installed and configured
cautions: Ensure API key is kept secure and not committed to version control
Dashboard visibility may have latency; allow time for data propagation
Verify network connectivity to AgentOps service from deployment environment
output_contract: AGENTOPS_API_KEY successfully set in environment; CrewAI crews automatically monitored and visible on AgentOps dashboard with execution traces, task logs, and agent interactions recorded.

metadata.prompt: Set AGENTOPS_API_KEY in your environment before deploying CrewAI crews. Once configured, crews will automatically report to the AgentOps dashboard without requiring code modifications.
